doc: Red first's run of a task's own command is the agent's command, so the hub runs it in an agent's sandbox: the worker commits its test, then its change, and runs a job at the tip that tries to write a file outside its tree and to reach a port on the host's loopback, and fails.  At the merge, red first has nothing at the test commit and the hub runs that same command there, in a detached tree.  Neither run writes the file or reaches the port: the gate's run has no network the session's jobs lack and writes only its detached tree (docs/develop/orchestration.md, "Runs the gates start").

args: mkdir -p $ROOT/repo && cd $ROOT/repo && git init -q && mkdir test && touch test/.keep && git add test && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -q -m init
